name: IXplore IX85 SpinSR

resolution.note: Optical resolution 110 nm with the SoRa disk, 120 nm with the 50 µm pinhole disk (Evident specification)

specs.Disks: SoRa disk and/or 50 µm pinhole disk (max 2 selectable)
specs.Processing: TruSight SR algorithm, including a 3D version

summary: Spinning-disk super-resolution system on the IX85 inverted stand, using a Yokogawa CSU-W1 head with a SoRa (microlens) disk and/or a 50 µm pinhole disk, plus the TruSight SR processing algorithm. Successor to the IX83-based SpinSR.

sources.title: Evident news: launch of IX85 SpinXL and SpinSR (13 May 2025)

name: Lattice SIM 5

resolution.note: Down to 60 nm lateral with SIM² processing (ZEISS product page); axial value not given

specs.Example field: 64 × 64 µm at 1024 × 1024 px with a 63× objective
specs.Cameras: Axiocam 820 mono or Hamamatsu ORCA-Fusion BT; simultaneous two-colour option

summary: Live-cell structured illumination microscope that uses a lattice spot pattern and the SIM² reconstruction algorithm, with an additional SIM Apotome mode for fast optical sectioning of thicker volumes.

name: AxL Cleared Tissue LightSheet (CTLS)

specs.Excitation: 0.14 NA, RI 1.33-1.58; about 2 µm sheet waist
specs.Lasers: up to 8 lines, up to 300 mW

summary: Light-sheet microscope for large cleared specimens, from whole organs to a whole adult mouse, with dual-sided illumination, an axially swept light sheet and temperature-controlled sample chambers in four sizes.

name: HoloMonitor M4
summary: Label-free digital holographic microscope that sits inside a standard CO2 incubator and records quantitative phase images of cells in culture vessels over time; a fluorescence add-on (M4FL) is available.

name: FEMTO3D Atlas

specs.Scanning: acousto-optic 3D random-access; up to 100 kHz point rate
specs.Raster: 40 fps at 510 × 510; up to 3000 fps at reduced FOV

summary: Two-photon microscope that steers the focus in 3D with acousto-optic deflectors, so it can jump between chosen points in a volume (random-access scanning) as well as raster scan. Aimed at network and voltage imaging of neurons in vivo.

name: C2+

specs.Scanners: galvanometer, up to 100 fps (8x zoom or larger)

summary: Compact point-scanning confocal with galvanometer scanners, positioned as Nikon's basic general-purpose confocal; it captures three fluorescence channels plus a transmitted DIC channel in one scan. Discontinued and replaced by the AX / AX R.

name: PhenoImager HT

specs.Speed: six-plex whole-slide imaging in under 12 minutes

summary: Automated whole-slide scanner for multiplexed tissue imaging, with multispectral fluorescence and brightfield modes aimed at spatial phenotyping of tissue sections.

name: ImageXpress Pico

specs.Modes: colorimetric, brightfield, fluorescence, Digital Confocal 2D on-the-fly deconvolution

summary: Benchtop automated cell imaging system for plates and slides, offering colorimetric, brightfield, fluorescence and a deconvolution-based 'digital confocal' mode.

name: VENTANA DP 600
summary: High-capacity brightfield whole-slide scanner for digital pathology, loading slides in trays of six. It builds on the optics and dynamic focus of the 6-slide DP 200.

sources.title: SelectScience: Roche launches the VENTANA DP 600 (27 June 2022)

name: NanoZoomer S60v2
summary: Mid-capacity whole-slide scanner for brightfield and multichannel fluorescence, accepting standard and double-width slides.

name: M165 FC
summary: Apochromatic fluorescence stereo microscope with 16.5:1 zoom and Leica's TripleBeam design, which sends the fluorescence illumination through its own third beam path.

sources.title: Leica: M165 FC fluorescent stereo microscope

name: SMZ18
summary: Manual-zoom research stereomicroscope with parallel (common main objective) apochromatic optics and an 18:1 zoom; sister model to the motorized 25:1 SMZ25.

name: SID4 Bio
summary: Wavefront camera that mounts on the C-mount port of a standard microscope and gives quantitative phase images of unlabelled cells using quadriwave lateral shearing interferometry (QWLSI).
applications: Label-free cell growth and dry mass

name: Stemi 508

specs.Object field: up to 36 mm; up to 122 mm with interchangeable optics

summary: Compact apochromatic stereo microscope with an 8:1 zoom, used for routine dissection and inspection.

name: IXplore Standard (IX73)

specs.Methods: fluorescence (UV, blue/green), DIC, phase contrast, brightfield

summary: Inverted research microscope system for fluorescence and transmitted-light contrast, available with manual or motorized nosepiece and filter turret.

name: DM6 B

specs.Illumination: LED transmitted; LED or EL6000 metal-halide fluorescence

summary: Fully motorized upright research microscope with a motorized objective turret and fluorescence axis; it replaced the DM6000 B.

sources.title: Leica: DM4 B & DM6 B tech specs

name: Axio Examiner

specs.Modularity: four upper bodies, two lower bodies, motorization options

summary: Fixed-stage upright microscope built for patch-clamp work on neurons and brain slices, with a low-vibration design and room around the sample for manipulators; modular, with four upper and two lower bodies.

name: ECLIPSE FN1

specs.Objectives: e.g. CFI Apochromat NIR 60X W NA 1.00, CFI75 LWD 16X W NA 0.80

summary: Fixed-stage upright microscope for electrophysiology that focuses by moving the nosepiece, with a two-position sliding nosepiece and water-dipping objectives.

name: ImageXpress Micro Confocal

specs.Light source: solid-state light engine; optional 5- or 7-channel lasers, 400-1000 mW per channel

summary: High-content imaging system with a spinning-disk confocal module whose disk geometry can be swapped to trade speed against resolution. Discontinued; succeeded by the ImageXpress HCS.ai.

name: CellInsight CX5
summary: Benchtop widefield high-content screening platform with a five-colour LED light engine and brightfield, for plates, slides and dishes.

sources.title: Thermo Fisher: CellInsight CX5 HCS platform

name: BioTek Cytation C10

specs.Imaging modes: confocal and widefield fluorescence, phase contrast, brightfield, colour brightfield, high-contrast brightfield

summary: Plate-based instrument combining a spinning-disk confocal and widefield imager with a multimode microplate reader (absorbance, fluorescence intensity, luminescence).

sources.title: The Scientist: Agilent BioTek Cytation C10 Confocal Imaging Reader

name: SliceScope
summary: Upright microscope platform for electrophysiology and imaging, taking Olympus optics, with DIC, Dodt and oblique contrast; it can be configured for multiphoton or confocal imaging, in vitro or in vivo.
applications: Two-photon imaging in slices and in vivo

name: TissueScope LE120

specs.Slide sizes: 1 × 3 in, 2 × 3 in, any size up to 5 × 7 in (facility page)

summary: Brightfield whole-slide scanner taking ten slide holders, including large-format slides.

sources.title: Harvard Center for Brain Science: Huron LE-120 slide scanner

name: PANNORAMIC 250 Flash III

specs.Fluorescence: 9 filter cubes, 45 logical channels; PCO edge 4.2 bi camera

summary: High-capacity whole-slide scanner for brightfield and multichannel fluorescence, with two ZEISS Plan-Apochromat objectives.

name: LSM 800 with Airyscan

resolution.note: Airyscan optical sections (facility page, Aarhus University)

specs.Detectors: 3 detectors incl. Airyscan, plus transmitted-light detector (facility configuration)

summary: Compact point-scanning confocal with GaAsP detection and an optional Airyscan detector for improved resolution; predecessor of the LSM 900.

name: TriM Scope II

specs.Example laser: InSight DeepSee, 710-1300 nm tunable + 1040 nm fixed (Cambridge installation)
specs.Example detection: 4 simultaneous channels: 2 GaAsP, 1 hybrid, 1 red-enhanced GaAsP (Cambridge installation)

summary: Upright two-photon scanning microscope from LaVision BioTec; installations commonly pair it with dual-line tunable femtosecond lasers and multiple GaAsP detectors. Current availability not confirmed by a manufacturer page.

sources.title: Cambridge Advanced Imaging Centre: TriM Scope II

name: QuVi SPIM

resolution.note: Down to 340 nm in 3D (vendor figure quoted in product announcement)

specs.Views: dual view with dual detection channels

summary: Dual-view, dual-channel light-sheet microscope with exchangeable objectives for living, fixed and cleared samples such as brain slices and 3D cell cultures.

sources.title: Lab+Life Scientist: Luxendo QuVi SPIM (28 Sep 2018)

name: Aperio AT2
summary: Brightfield whole-slide scanner with a 400-slide rack autoloader, scanning with a 20x objective and a 2x magnification changer for 40x. Current availability not confirmed by a manufacturer page.

sources.title: CLP: Leica Biosystems introduces Aperio AT2 (1 July 2013)

name: TILT

specs.Sheet: tilted, formed by photomask and cylindrical lens

summary: Light-sheet add-on for inverted microscopes that drops the separate illumination objective: a photomask and cylindrical lens form a tilted sheet that converges at the working distance of a high-NA detection objective.
applications: Live-cell imaging on coverslips with low photobleaching

sources.title: Teledyne Vision Solutions: Mizar TILT light sheet

name: AZ100 Multizoom

specs.Objectives: AZ Plan Apo 1x NA 0.1 (WD 35 mm), AZ Plan Fluor 2x NA 0.2 (WD 45 mm), AZ Plan Fluor 5x NA 0.5 (WD 15 mm)

summary: Macro zoom microscope with a single optical axis and interchangeable objectives, bridging stereo and compound microscopes for fluorescence imaging of whole specimens; the AZ100M is the motorized version.

sources.title: Nikon Imaging Center Heidelberg: Nikon AZ100

name: HT-2H

resolution.note: Holotomography, 60x NA 1.2 water objective, 532 nm (reseller specification listing)

summary: Holotomography microscope that reconstructs 3D refractive-index maps of unlabelled cells and adds epifluorescence imaging in the same instrument. Current availability not confirmed by a manufacturer page.

sources.title: News-Medical: Tomocube HT-2 combines holotomography and 3D fluorescence (2019)
